envelope.contentMd:
## Vision

# Vision

By the end of 2028, every shopfloor role at Leeds and Rotherham works from digital work instructions, every critical asset is covered by predictive maintenance, and Rotherham Line 3 runs a validated digital twin used for what-if planning ahead of every changeover.

## Roadmap by Horizon

## Roadmap by horizon

**2026** — Digital work instructions pilot (2 lines); Line 3 digital twin pilot; predictive maintenance sensors on critical assets.

**2027** — Digital work instructions to 80% of shopfloor roles; predictive maintenance rollout across both plants; warehouse automation wave 1 live.

**2028** — Digital twin extended to 2 additional lines; closed-loop quality data from supplier gate through to shopfloor.

## Investment Summary

## Investment summary

| Workstream | 2026 | 2027 | 2028 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Digital work instructions | £120k | £180k | £60k |
| Predictive maintenance | £340k | £260k | £80k |
| Digital twin | £210k | £90k | £140k |

## Risks & Dependencies

## Risks & dependencies

- Shopfloor Wi-Fi coverage must be upgraded at Rotherham before the digital twin pilot can scale
- Predictive maintenance sensor lead times run 8-10 weeks
- Depends on the warehouse automation wave 1 business case being approved
